svg.title: King of the Pit: a three-way king of the hill map
svg.desc: Turned inside out: the hill is a pit. A broad raised rim rings it, crowned with standing stones, and three graded roads go down from the rim at the gaps between the teams. Elsewhere the pit wall is too steep for vehicles (about 36°) but not for bots. Whoever holds the pit is looked down on from every side.
svg.text: 08 · King of the Pit · planet Selene
Three-way king of the hill · 16 × 16 map (8192 game units square) · 1v1v1 to 2v2v2
Turned inside out: the hill is a pit. A broad raised rim rings it, crowned with standing stones, and
three graded roads go down from the rim at the gaps between the teams. Elsewhere the pit wall is too
steep for vehicles (about 36°) but not for bots. Whoever holds the pit is looked down on from every side.
Heights: plateau 260 · rim 300 · the pit wall drops 260 in about 360 · the pit floor (the capture zone) 40
Planet Selene · an airless grey moon
Ground: fine grey regolith, bright ejecta rays running out from the pit, dark impact glass on the
pit floor, rover tracks for roads.
Features: rocks30_def boulders thrown out round the rim, rocks30_map for the standing stones,
pilha_crystal_quartz in the pit, the corpse wrecks of a lost landing on the plateau.
Sky and weather: black sky, no haze, hard sunlight; wind 0 to 2; tidal 0; solar power only; gravity
90 against BAR's usual 130 (check in play what it does to artillery).
Each third is the same, turned 120° about the hill. Heights in game units; lighter ground stands higher.
